summary: SunPower Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an additional issuance of 10.00% Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2029 under an existing indenture. The notes are senior secured obligations maturing May 1, 2029, with interest payable quarterly. Holders may convert at $1,000 principal into common stock at an initial conversion price of ~$1.64 per share. The company cannot redeem the notes, but holders can require repurchase upon a fundamental change. This is a routine debt issuance under a prior agreement, not a special situation. No terms such as price per share, premium, or break fee are applicable. Watch for conversion activity or fundamental change events.
